The '''Dartiss-5 Caravel''' was a barge-like [[Hutt/Legends|Huttian]] design produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]].<ref name="TNA" />

Consisting of a [[Sail barge|barge]]-like form, the Dartiss had a four person cockpit at the front of the ship on the top deck; connected to the cockpit was a corridor, which held thirteen cabins and two airlocks divided between the port and starboard sides.<ref name="TNA" /> Each cabin measured four by six meters, and was capable of comfortably housing four passengers - aft of the cabins at the end of the corridor was a small engineering section, as well as a [[turbolift]] that led to the cargo deck.<ref name="TNA" />

Used by Hutts as space [[Yacht]]s, older Dartiss-5's that were in disrepair were known to fall into the hands of non-Hutts for use as transports and smuggling vessels, as was the case with the the ''[[Lost Lady]]''.<ref name="TNA" /> Extremely modifiable, the Dartiss could be heavily modified - the [[Lost Lady]] having heavy shields, armor, [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]], and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] launchers.<ref name="TNA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Because the [[Lost Lady]] is the only known ship of this type, the stock unmodified stats of the Dartiss-5 cannot be known; hyperdrive, armament, and all other attributes may be significantly different from those listed.
